_about: Money categories added beyond the original brief: loan, insurance, salary. Synthetic emails, multiple vendors including a messy HTML format, plus two money-family promo decoys — a pre-approved-loan blast and an insurance-renewal offer, the most realistic Indian false positives in this domain. No real user data.
